candidate.definition_en: To intercept and hold something; to get on a bus or train; to become infected.
candidate.explanation_ar: تمسك حاجة بتطير في الهوا، أو تلحق الأتوبيس، أو حتى يجيلك دور برد.

senses.definition_en: To intercept and hold something in motion.
senses.example: Throw the ball and I will catch it.

senses.definition_en: To be in time to board a bus, train, or other public vehicle.
senses.example: I need to catch the bus.

senses.definition_en: To become infected with an illness.

examples: Throw the ball and I will catch it.
I need to catch the bus.
